Aapke order (ORD-22003) ki delivery status "delivered" dikha raha hai aur carrier DTDC hai. 

Agar aapko parcel nahi mila hai, toh main ise further investigate karne ke liye ya refund/replacement ke liye human agent ko transfer kar deta hoon. Kya aap chahte hain ki main human agent se connect karoon?
